# Biomedical

> > Biomedical is a Brazilian medical device distributor based in Belo Horizonte, MG, specializing in vascular intervention, dialysis, and cardiology products with ANVISA-regulated technologies.

The company distributes advanced medical devices including Philips AngioSculpt catheters, Stellarex drug-coated balloons, Flixene Dacron grafts, and hemodialysis solutions. Biomedical serves hospitals across Brasil with innovative vascular access systems, scoring balloon catheters, and patient identification solutions.

## Key Topics

- Dispositivos médicos (Medical devices)
- Acesso vascular (Vascular access)
- Cateter balão (Balloon catheters)
- Angioplastia
- Cardiologia intervencionista
- Procedimentos vasculares
- Hemodiálise

## Vascular Intervention & Angioplasty

- [AngioSculpt EVO – Biomedical](https://biomedical.com.br/portfolio-item/angiosculpt-evo): Philips AngioSculpt EVO scoring balloon catheter for coronary intervention
- [Stellarex – Balão Farmacológico para Angioplastia – Biomedical](https://biomedical.com.br/portfolio-item/stellarex-balao-farmacologico-para-angioplastia-2): Stellarex drug-coated balloon with paclitaxel and EnduraCoat technology
- [Cateter Laser Elca – Biomedical](https://biomedical.com.br/portfolio-item/cateter-laser-elca-2): ELCA laser catheter for coronary atherectomy and lesion treatment
- [AGULHAS ANGIOGRÁFICAS – Biomedical](https://biomedical.com.br/portfolio-item/agulhas-angiograficas): KDL angiographic puncture needles with Luer Lock for vascular access

## Vascular Access Systems

- [Speed Cross Twist – Sistema de Acesso Deflectivel – Biomedical](https://biomedical.com.br/portfolio-item/speed-cross-twist-sistema-de-acesso-deflectivel): Deflectable access system with Flexsteer tech for vascular procedures
- [TightRail – Bainha de dilatação mecânica rotacional – Biomedical](https://biomedical.com.br/portfolio-item/tightrail-bainha-de-dilatacao-mecanica-rotacional-2): TightRail rotational mechanical dilation sheath for electrode placement
- [Enxerto de Dacron – Knitted Impregnado com Colágeno – Biomedical](https://biomedical.com.br/portfolio-item/enxerto-de-dacron-knitted-impregnado-com-colageno): VUP Medical Dacron knitted vascular graft with collagen impregnation

## Hemodialysis Solutions

- [Cateteres de Hemodiálise – Biomedical](https://biomedical.com.br/portfolio-item/cateteres-de-hemodialise): Hemodialysis catheters with dual/triple lumen and Dolphin kit products
- [Fístula para Diálise e o Papel do Flixene](https://biomedical.com.br/fistula-para-dialise-e-o-papel-do-flixene-2): Flixene Dacron graft role in dialysis fistula vascular procedures

## Patient Safety & Identification

- [Biomedical | Identificação de Pacientes](https://biomedical.com.br/identificacao-de-pacientes): Patient safety wristbands with barcode for hospitals and ICU neonatal
